title: OrderItem
description: A single line on an order. lineType drives interpretation: bundles use parentLineId to link components; supplemental shipping lines carry freight as a line; promotional lines carry discounts as negative-effect lines.

lineId.description: Stable unique identifier for this line within the order. Use a GUID or a deterministic line key; do not reuse across orders.

parentLineId.description: For BUNDLE_COMPONENT lines, the lineId of the BUNDLE_PARENT they belong to. Null for all other line types.

sku.description: Your canonical SKU / item number. The business identity of the product, independent of any channel's product id.

productName.description: Human-readable description as it should appear on documents.

quantity.description: Ordered quantity. Supports decimal for weight/length-based items.

unitOfMeasure.description: UOM the quantity is expressed in (EA, CASE, LB, FT). Free-form for V1; may become an enum later.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit before line-level discounts.

lineDiscounts.description: Discounts applied specifically to this line.

lineTotal.description: Extended total for the line after line-level discounts (quantity * unitPrice - discounts). Tax excluded unless taxInclusive is true at order level.

fulfillmentGroupId.description: Which fulfillment group ships this line. Links to fulfillment.fulfillmentGroups[].groupId. Null only on lines that are never shipped (e.g. pure discount lines).

references.description: External identifiers for this line, keyed by system. Lets adapters round-trip without polluting canonical fields.

extensions.description: Channel-specific or future line data. See order.schema.json extensions guidance.

code.description: Promo code or contract reference, if applicable.

amount.description: The discount value applied to the line (positive number representing the reduction).
